notes: Proved: overpartitions p(m) = sum over partitions of 2^(distinct parts) is 2*tau(m) mod 4, so A219430(n) = 2 mod 4 (n >= 1); then a(n) = n b(n) - sum_{k<n} a(k) b(n-k) with all a(k) even gives a(n) = 2n mod 4. Lean main theorem A219431_main (Mathlib Nat.Partition, Nat.card_divisors). Outside Lean: none beyond reading overpartitions as sum 2^(distinct parts) and the log derivative as the coefficient identity G*A = xG'.

sources.cite: M. D. Hirschhorn, J. A. Sellers, Arithmetic relations for overpartitions, JCMCC 53 (2005)
sources.what: overpartition counts mod small powers of 2 (p(m) = 2 mod 4 iff m a nonzero square)

prior_art.note: Input fact on overpartitions mod 4 is classical; the log-derivative congruence appears unproved before.
